title: Searching for Non-Pixel Art RPG Maker game Inspiration!

posts.author: Axgin96
posts.body:
Hi everyone! I'm new around here and I had a question.
Are there any RPG Maker games (any version) that
don’t
use pixel art, but instead go for a more hand-drawn or illustrated vibe?
I know RPG Maker uses a 48x48 tile grid, which tends to favor pixel art, but I believe with the right art style, even clean-line or more "drawn" visuals can work quite well.
Personally, I'm working on a custom tileset for a personal project, and I’m trying to go for a more unique and personal art style — also because I'm not really a pixel artist, haha.
So I was wondering: are there any RPG Maker games out there that use a non-pixel art visual style? If so, could you recommend some? I'd love to check them out and see what others have done!
Thanks in advance for any suggestions!
Here’s an example of the tiles I’m working on

posts.author: HB_Games
posts.body:
Cool! I remember that I considered to work on someting in a more hand drawn style, but my issue was with rpg maker resolution. I couldn't keep a decent definition working under the rpg maker default sizes and couldn't change default sizes without breaking all the layouts of the game. So ended up deciding to wait for the release of some HD Rpg Maker .
:/
